{{Quote|Greetings, Jedi. It would seem once again one of your Order has lost his way. And even better, a leading member of your Jedi Council. Listen to me, Jedi. I do not care about your politics. I do not care about your Republic. I only live to see you die!|Grievous, in a message to the Jedi Council|audio=LiveToSeeYouDie-GI.flac|<ref name="GI" />}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] was '''captured''' by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] during a [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] battle deep in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], near the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]]. Koth's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and his [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the [[Steadfast (Venator-class)/Legends|''Steadfast'']], was assailed by a fleet of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] led by Grievous and subsequently boarded by the general and his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces. While [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]] engaged [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] commanded by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lock (Clone Captain)/Legends|Lock]] on the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] lower levels, Grievous made his way to the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] alongside a contingent of [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|droid commandos]] and [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] all of the bridge's defenders with the exception of Master Koth, who was soon defeated and taken captive by Grievous and his MagnaGuards. Koth was later displayed as a hostage in a transmission sent by Grievous to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. The transmission provoked the Order's [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|attempt]] to rescue Koth and capture Grievous in a conflict over [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].

==Prelude==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 21" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member and [[Jedi General/Legends|Grand Army General]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] was traveling [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in a hunt for Confederate agents.<ref name="Jedi Heroes">''[[The Clone Wars: Jedi Heroes]]''</ref> At the same time, the Confederate [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], was planning to target a member of the High Council for capture in order to convey his hatred of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to its leaders.<ref name="Ep guide" />

==The capture==
{{Quote|Your reputation precedes you, General&mdash;the reputation of a coward and a murderer.''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''Murderer?'' Is it murder to rid the galaxy of you Jedi filth?|Eeth Koth and General Grievous|audio=CowardAndMurderer-GI.flac|<ref name="GI" />}}
Not far from the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]]<ref name="FF-2014 21" /> deep in the Outer Rim,<ref name="Ep guide" /> the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] Grievous led a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of five [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] and [[Grievous's Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|his own ''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] in an interception<ref name="GI" /> of the [[Steadfast (Venator-class)/Legends|''Steadfast'']],<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] commanded by General Koth. Grievous's and Koth's [[Starship/Legends|starships]] lined up with one another and exchanged heavy broadside fire, resulting in considerable damage for both vessels. However, Grievous's [[Warship/Legends|warship]] quickly overpowered the Star Destroyer, forcing it into submission.<ref name="GI" />

On the ''Steadfast''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], Eeth Koth and a contingent of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] prepared for Grievous's inevitable boarding. At one of the Star Destroyer's [[Airlock/Legends|airlocks]] on the lower levels of the ship,<ref name="GI" /> [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Lock (Clone Captain)/Legends|Lock]] and the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] of [[Horn Company]]<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> assumed defensive positions shortly before [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] used an armored docking tube to board the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and poured into the Republic vessel.<ref name="Ep guide" /> During the boarding, the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] was contacted by Koth and reported that there were too many [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] for them to repel.<ref name="GI" /> The [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]]<ref name="Hasbro Lock" /> ordered Lock to take his men to the ship's [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] while he assumed the responsibility of combating Grievous himself on the bridge.<ref name="GI" /> The [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] complied and were able to evacuate the ''Steadfast'' before it was overrun.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" />

[[File:Koth_torture.png|thumb|left|280px|Eeth Koth is subdued and tortured by Grievous and his forces.]]
Koth's communication with Lock was cut immediately before the Confederate general reached the bridge's [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] and began to slice into it with one of his many [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. Once a large section of the door was free, Grievous kicked it into the bridge, causing the metal slabs to slam into an unsuspecting clone. The general walked onto the bridge, flanked by a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of four [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] that quickly proceeded to slay Koth's [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. The four [[Droid/Legends|droids]] then set upon the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], and landed a shot on Koth's elbow, causing him to drop his lightsaber. The droids attempted to execute the unarmed Koth, but were stopped by a surviving clone who shot one of the droid [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] in the head. Koth destroyed the remaining commandos before Grievous was joined by four [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] who killed the last clone and surrounded the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="GI" />

With Koth trapped, Grievous leaped onto a communications console and regarded the Jedi Master, who derided the general for being a coward and a murderer. Grievous retorted that his only goal was to kill the Jedi and ignited two lightsabers before kicking Koth squarely in the chest. The Jedi Master was knocked toward the bridge's command walkway, followed closely by Grievous and the MagnaGuards. Grievous lunged at Koth, who parried the blows as he retreated toward the main [[Viewport/Legends|viewports]] of the bridge. When ample distance was placed between the two combatants, Koth [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically threw]] the general into a viewport with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Before the Jedi could press the attack, however, two of the MagnaGuards jabbed him in the back with their [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]], stopping his advance. Grievous recovered from his impact with the viewport and locked sabers with the weakened Koth, who was once again electrocuted by the MagnaGuards. The Jedi Master fell to his knees and was electrocuted again, and Grievous seized the advantage by grabbing Koth by his neck and lifting him off the ground. Defeated, Koth was taken to Grievous's [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] as a hostage.<ref name="GI" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:JediHighCouncilGrievousTransmission-GrievousIntrigue.jpg|thumb|right|280px|The Jedi Council watches Grievous's torture of Koth.]]
{{Quote|It's time somebody finally put an end to that monster.|Anakin Skywalker, on Grievous|audio=Monster-GI.flac|<ref name="GI" />}}
Grievous later displayed the captive Koth in a transmission sent to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], in which the general explained that his entire reason for living was to end the lives of Jedi. The cyborg had Koth brutally tortured in the transmission, which was viewed by members of the High Council as well as other Jedi, including several [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]]. Despite his suffering, Koth was able to use coded hand signals during the transmission that indicated Grievous was bound for the [[Saleucami system/Legends|Saleucami system]]. Jedi Council members [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], along with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], used this information to plan an [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|assault]] on Grievous's forces in an attempt to rescue the hostage Jedi Master and capture the general.<ref name="GI" /> Unbeknown to the Jedi, Grievous was simply using Koth as bait in a trap meant to ensnare his two most hated foes: Generals Kenobi and Skywalker.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" />

==Behind the scenes==
The capture of Eeth Koth was featured in the ninth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, titled "[[Grievous Intrigue]]."<ref name="Ep guide" /> Koth, who was previously established to have been killed in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], was [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] into having survived the battle so that he could appear in the episode. The original plot for the episode had Grievous killing the Jedi Master during the battle instead of capturing him. This was later changed, as Series Director [[Dave Filoni]] wished to be able to use Koth for future episodes.<ref name="GI commentary">{{SW|url=video/grievous-intrigue-episode-featurette|text="Grievous Intrigue" Episode Featurette}}</ref>
